senses.gloss:
1. लुड् लुड्, and लुल् लुल्, i. 1, [] Par. To agitate, to stir, to disturb.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लुलित.
 1. Agitated, Rām. 1, 42, 29.
 2. Shaken, Utt. Rāmac. 140, 3.
 3. Heaving, panting, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 15; Lass. 20, 20.
 4. Destroyed.
 --Caus. लोडय, To agitate, MBh. 1, 2833. Ptcple of the pf. pass.
 I. लोडित, Troubled, Rām. 2, 95, 18.
 II. लोलित, Agitated, Śiś. 9, 4.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अन्-अभि-लुलित, Without being touched, Śāk. d. 61.
 --With आ आ, Caus. लोडय,
 1. To trouble, MBh. 1, 7921; with जालैस्, Pañc. 78, 14 (see my transl. n. 374, ‘To fish out,’ cf. वि).
 2. To mix, MBh. 4, 689.
 --With समा सम्-आ, Caus. लोडय,
 1. To mix, MBh. 3, 11471.
 2. To reflect, Skandap., Kāśīkh. 10, 48.
 --With परि परि, Caus. लोडय, To agitate, to disturb, MBh. 2, 389.
 --With वि वि, विलुलित,
 1. Tremulous.
 2. Falling, shed fast (viz. tears), Utt. Rāmac. 68, 12.
 --Caus. लोडय,
 1. To disturb, MBh. 2, 11604.
 2. To fish out, MBh. 12, 4901.
 --With सम् सम्, Caus. लोडय, To disturb, MBh. 1, 1477.

† 2. लुड् लुड्, i. 6, Par.
 1. To adhere, to be attached.
 2. To cover.
